name: ANCHOR UNDER SIEGE / CAST RIOT
sequence_kind: synthetic DNA-like instruction string; not designed for biological function

environment.harmony_system: Bright close-harmony major-sixth sonorities periodically forced into suspended fourths and narrow dissonant upper clusters; dry and rhythmically exact.
environment.melodic_system: Short pennywhistle-like four-note cell plus clipped yodel flips and chromatic relay fragments; melody can hocket across a cast.
environment.rhythmic_system: Base pulse around 105 BPM with activity pulse near 210 BPM; 3-against-4 grouping pressure, brief additive-meter incursions, hard stops, and event-driven transitions.
environment.timbre_atmosphere_system: Dry kit, elastic/slap bass, bright whistle, cheap fuzz organ, short spring-reverb attacks, handclaps, and deliberate medium damage late in the form.
environment.performance_attitude: Deadpan technician precision at first; increasingly populated by excitable respondents, hecklers, chanters, and a mob that acquires musical jobs.
environment.anchor_invariant: A four-note bright whistle cell, always recognizable by contour even when pitch, performer, register, or surface changes.

protected_logic: PITCH_ANCHOR_DECLARE immediately after TTA protection markers
notes: The same A/C/G/T carrier has two readings: SLOP-SEQ decodes it as composition instructions; Seq2Music independently sonifies it as DNA.
